description: Save chosen files of one asset to a local folder, re-checking at the source that it is still CC0 first. Creates <dir>/<asset id>/, saves each file there with its companions (a glTF's .bin and textures) at the relative paths the main file expects, and writes cc0.json recording the source, creator, license evidence, riskFlags and download time, so the project keeps proof of where the asset came from. Use it after search_assets (and get_asset when the asset has several files, to read their labels) when the user wants the asset in their project; use get_asset instead when they only want links. Pages that need the user's login (Sketchfab, BlenderKit, Freesound originals) are not downloaded and come back in `skipped`. Zip packs (ambientCG) are saved as-is, not extracted. Behavior: writes files under `dir` only, overwriting same-named files from an earlier download of the same asset; live HTTPS downloads, up to 1 GB per file.

dir.description: Folder to save into, normally inside the user's project (e.g. 'assets/cc0'). A subfolder named after the asset id is created. Relative paths resolve against the server's working directory

files.description: Exact file labels from get_asset, e.g. ['gltf / 1k / gltf'] or ['1K-JPG (zip)']. Leave out only when the asset has a single file; otherwise the call fails and lists the labels

id.description: Asset id exactly as returned by search_assets

name: download_asset

folder.description: Absolute path of the folder created for this asset

receipt.description: Absolute path of cc0.json: id, title, creator, source URLs, license evidence, riskFlags and download time

saved.description: Files written, including each model's companion files at their relative paths

label.description: File label from get_asset; companions read '<main label> + <path>'

skipped.description: Files not saved and why, e.g. a page that needs the user's login; tell the user and give them landingUrl

title: Download a CC0 asset with a license receipt
